title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Exemption Grounds and Refund Method
content:
The VA Home Loan Guaranty lists, for each program, the grounds on which a veteran or surviving spouse is exempt from the funding fee, whether a funding fee already paid is refunded when compensation is later awarded effective on or before the closing date, and how a funding fee refund is paid.

## Exemption grounds (identical on every program)

1. Receiving VA compensation.
2. Entitled to compensation but receiving retired pay or active-duty pay instead.
3. Holding a pre-discharge rating or a proposed rating.
4. Being a surviving spouse receiving Dependency and Indemnity Compensation.
5. Being a Purple Heart recipient on active duty.

## Refund terms by program

| Program | Exemption grounds | Fee refunded on a later award effective on or before closing | Refund method |
|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | Grounds 1 to 5 | Yes | Paid by VA to the veteran by direct deposit or check |

## Questions the terms answer

**Does the program a loan was made under change the exemption grounds?** No. All seven programs carry the same five grounds.

**Who pays a funding fee refund, and to whom?** VA pays it to the veteran, by direct deposit or by check; this is the same on every program.

**Is a fee refundable when the compensation award comes after closing?** On every program, yes, where the award is effective on or before the closing date.
